items.statement: The published evidence will support activation as associated with fewer heat-related emergency visits but will not show a benefit from lowering the threshold.
items.rationale: Time-series evidence for activation; imprecise evidence for thresholds.
items.risks: New studies may change the picture.

items.statement: Targeted outreach and transport will have more evidence of reaching those at risk than public alerts alone.
items.rationale: Interview and cooling centre evidence point this way.

items.statement: No published study will allow a cost per emergency visit avoided for this region.
items.rationale: The regional costing had no effect data.
